overview_description.description:
Tripz is a highly scalable mobility and FinTech ecosystem tailored for the Egyptian market. Moving beyond traditional ride-hailing models, Tripz is built on a proprietary, self-hosted routing and mapping infrastructure, successfully bypassing costly third-party Map APIs. This deep-tech architectural innovation reduces operational tech costs by ~80%, enabling sustainable and highly profitable unit economics in constrained emerging markets.

Built entirely by its Technical Founder (CTO), the platform offers 8 specialized ride categories and has rapidly scaled to over 6,700 active users, including 4,500+ drivers, demonstrating an exceptional Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) of under $1 during its pilot phase.
